# LabFlow LIMS — Laboratory Information Management System

> LabFlow is a cloud-based Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) built for pathology labs, diagnostic centers, and medical laboratories across India.

## What is LabFlow?

LabFlow is a modern, web-based LIMS platform that helps pathology and diagnostic laboratories manage their entire workflow — from patient registration and sample tracking to test reporting, billing, and analytics. It is trusted by 500+ labs across India.

## Website

https://labflow.mywebz.in

## Key Features

- Patient Management: Complete patient profiles, history tracking, auto-generated IDs
- Test & Report Management: Manage test types, generate professional PDF reports, track sample status
- Billing & Invoicing: Automated invoicing, GST support, partial payments, ledger management
- Multi-Branch Support: Centralized management for labs with multiple branches
- Role-Based Access Control: Secure multi-role system (Super Admin, Lab Admin, Operator, Doctor)
- Analytics Dashboard: Real-time dashboards, revenue insights, collection reports
- Document Storage: Upload and manage patient documents with letterhead support
- Follow-up Reminders: Automated patient follow-up tracking
- WhatsApp Integration: Send reports and notifications via WhatsApp
- Barcode/QR Support: Generate and scan barcodes for samples
- PWA Support: Works offline as a Progressive Web App
- Multi-Language: Available in English, Hindi, and Marathi

## Target Audience

- Pathology laboratories in India
- Diagnostic centers and medical labs
- Multi-branch laboratory chains
- Hospital laboratory departments
- Clinical reference laboratories

## Pricing

- Starter: ₹199/month — Single branch, up to 500 patients/month
- Professional: ₹299/month — Up to 3 branches, unlimited patients, advanced analytics
- Enterprise: Custom pricing — Unlimited branches, dedicated support, custom integrations

## Compliance

- NABL compliant workflows
- ISO 15189 compatible
- GST-ready billing
- HIPAA-aware data handling

## Contact

- Website: https://labflow.mywebz.in

## Technical Details

- Platform: Cloud-based web application (SaaS)
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind CSS
- Deployment: Available as cloud-hosted or on-premise
- Mobile: Responsive design + PWA for mobile access
- API: RESTful API for integrations
